name: tan
comment: Sig: y = tan(x). SIMD via ported SLEEF xtan (Cody-Waite reduction + degree-7 half-angle polynomial + tan double-angle), replacing Div(Sin,Cos). 2-step reduction for |x|<15 (y1-y5), extended PI_A..D for |x|<1e6 (y6 x=10, y7 x=100, y8 x=1000, y9 x=50000); |x|>=1e6 falls to scalar std::tan. <=3.5 ULP, bit-identical MATLAB R2025b on probed inputs (incl. large args via extended reduction).
